pages.text: 晚饭后，Tina妈妈把咘咘抱在腿上，轻轻说：“宝贝，我们要回深圳了。”咘咘歪着头问：“回深圳？那幼儿园呢？那艳艳老师呢？”
pages.text_en: After dinner, Mama Tina held Bubu on her lap and said softly: "Sweetheart, we're moving back to Shenzhen." Bubu tilted her head: "Back to Shenzhen? What about kindergarten? What about Teacher Yanyan?"

pages.text: 咘咘的眼圈红了。Tina妈妈把她搂紧：“我知道你舍不得，妈妈也舍不得。但是深圳也有很棒的幼儿园，会有新老师、新朋友。”Sam爸爸蹲下来，摸摸咘咘的头：“而且Oliver在深圳等你呢。”
pages.text_en: Bubu's eyes turned red. Mama Tina hugged her tight: "I know you'll miss everyone, Mama will too. But Shenzhen has wonderful kindergartens too, with new teachers and new friends." Papa Sam knelt down and patted her head: "And Oliver is waiting for you in Shenzhen."

pages.text: 星期一早上，咘咘穿上她最喜欢的粉红色裙子，背上小书包。“今天是我在苏州幼儿园的最后一天。”她站在幼儿园门口，看了好久好久。
pages.text_en: Monday morning, Bubu put on her favorite pink dress and her little backpack. "Today is my last day at kindergarten in Suzhou." She stood at the kindergarten gate and looked at it for a long, long time.

pages.text: 走进教室，一切都好熟悉——墙上贴着小朋友们画的画，角落里的积木城堡还是上周搭的，窗台上的小花开了新的花苞。咘咘用手指轻轻碰了碰每一样东西，想把它们都记住。
pages.text_en: Walking into the classroom, everything felt so familiar — the children's drawings on the wall, the block castle in the corner still standing from last week, new flower buds blooming on the windowsill. Bubu gently touched each thing with her finger, trying to remember them all.

pages.text: 艳艳老师走过来，蹲下身子抱住咘咘：“我听说你要走了。老师好舍不得你啊。”咘咘搂着老师的脖子：“艳艳老师，我也舍不得你。你还记得我第一天来的时候吗？我哭了好久好久。”
pages.text_en: Teacher Yanyan walked over, knelt down, and hugged Bubu: "I heard you're leaving. I'm going to miss you so much." Bubu wrapped her arms around the teacher's neck: "Teacher Yanyan, I'll miss you too. Do you remember my first day here? I cried for so long."

pages.text: 艳艳老师笑了：“当然记得。你哭了一上午，后来是菲菲把自己的小饼干分给你，你才笑了。”咘咘也笑了，眼泪却掉了下来：“谢谢老师一直对我那么好。”
pages.text_en: Teacher Yanyan smiled: "Of course I remember. You cried all morning, and then Feifei shared her cookies with you, and you finally smiled." Bubu smiled too, but tears rolled down her cheeks: "Thank you for always being so kind to me, Teacher."

pages.text: 张老师也走过来了，她的眼睛也红红的。“咘咘，你要记得张老师教你的儿歌哦。”她拉着咘咘的手，两人一起唱起那首最爱的歌。唱着唱着，咘咘把头靠在张老师的肩膀上。
pages.text_en: Teacher Zhang came over too, her eyes a little red. "Bubu, remember the nursery rhymes I taught you, okay?" She held Bubu's hand, and they sang their favorite song together. As they sang, Bubu leaned her head on Teacher Zhang's shoulder.

pages.text: “张老师，你的声音最好听了，我到深圳也会唱给新朋友听的。”张老师使劲点头，声音有点发抖：“好，到时候告诉老师，新朋友喜不喜欢。”
pages.text_en: "Teacher Zhang, you have the prettiest voice. I'll sing for my new friends in Shenzhen too." Teacher Zhang nodded hard, her voice trembling a little: "Yes, tell me later if your new friends like it."

pages.text: 菲菲跑过来，一把抱住咘咘。两个好朋友紧紧抱在一起，谁都不说话。过了好久，菲菲小声说：“你走了，谁跟我一起荡秋千呀？”
pages.text_en: Feifei ran over and threw her arms around Bubu. The two best friends held each other tight, neither saying a word. After a long time, Feifei whispered: "When you leave, who will swing on the swings with me?"

pages.text: 咘咘拉着菲菲的手：“你还有莫瑜呀，还有大家呀。而且我们可以让妈妈帮我们打电话！”菲菲用力点头：“那你不许忘记我！”咘咘把小拇指伸出来：“拉钩，一百年不许变！”
pages.text_en: Bubu held Feifei's hand: "You still have Moyu and everyone else! And we can ask our moms to help us call each other!" Feifei nodded hard: "Then you can't forget me!" Bubu stuck out her pinky: "Pinky promise, never ever break it!"

pages.text: 放学前，小朋友们围着咘咘，把一张大大的卡片递给她。上面画满了歪歪扭扭的画——有咘咘和大家一起玩滑梯的样子，有一起吃午饭的样子，角落里还有莫瑜画的一只胖胖的小狗。卡片上写着：“咘咘，我们会想你的！”
pages.text_en: Before school ended, the children gathered around Bubu and handed her a big card. It was covered with wobbly drawings — Bubu playing on the slide with everyone, eating lunch together, and in the corner, a chubby little dog drawn by Moyu. The card read: "Bubu, we'll miss you!"

pages.text: 咘咘也从书包里拿出一袋小礼物。“这是我和妈妈一起准备的！”每个小袋子里有一颗棒棒糖和一张咘咘画的小卡片——上面画着咘咘和每位小朋友在一起的样子。
pages.text_en: Bubu reached into her backpack and took out a bag of little gifts. "Mama and I made these together!" Each little bag had a lollipop and a small card Bubu had drawn — each one showing Bubu with that friend.

pages.text: 大家围成一个圈，把咘咘抱在中间。艳艳老师、张老师也加入了。“我们永远是好朋友！”所有人一起喊。咘咘哭了，但她笑着哭。NOMI坐在旁边，悄悄擦了擦眼睛。NONO拍着翅膀在咘咘肩膀上蹭了蹭。
pages.text_en: Everyone formed a circle and hugged Bubu in the middle. Teacher Yanyan and Teacher Zhang joined in too. "We'll be friends forever!" everyone cheered. Bubu cried, but she cried with a smile. NOMI sat nearby, quietly wiping her eyes. NONO flapped his wings and nuzzled against Bubu's shoulder.

pages.text: 星期二，Sam爸爸开车带着全家出发了。咘咘趴在车窗上，看着苏州的房子、树和河一点一点变小。“再见了，苏州。”她轻轻说。
pages.text_en: On Tuesday, Papa Sam drove the whole family out of the city. Bubu pressed her face against the car window, watching the houses, trees, and rivers of Suzhou grow smaller and smaller. "Goodbye, Suzhou," she whispered.

pages.text: 在飞机上，咘咘看着窗外的白云，想起菲菲跟她拉钩的样子，想起艳艳老师温暖的拥抱，想起张老师好听的歌声。她把同学们送的卡片抱在怀里，闭上眼睛笑了笑。
pages.text_en: On the airplane, Bubu gazed at the white clouds outside, thinking of Feifei's pinky promise, Teacher Yanyan's warm hug, and Teacher Zhang's beautiful singing. She held the card from her classmates close to her chest, closed her eyes, and smiled.

pages.text: 到深圳了！Tina妈妈带咘咘路过一个新幼儿园。透过栅栏，咘咘看见里面有好大的滑梯、漂亮的沙坑，还有几个小朋友在草地上追泡泡。“妈妈，那个幼儿园好漂亮！”咘咘拉着妈妈的手，眼睛亮了起来。
pages.text_en: They arrived in Shenzhen! Mama Tina took Bubu past a new kindergarten. Through the fence, Bubu saw a huge slide, a pretty sandbox, and some children chasing bubbles on the grass. "Mama, that kindergarten is so pretty!" Bubu tugged Mama's hand, her eyes lighting up.

pages.text: 晚上，咘咘躺在深圳家里的小床上，NOMI坐在枕头旁边，NONO在床头灯上打着小呼噜。咘咘看着天花板上的星星夜灯，轻轻说：“苏州的朋友们，晚安。明天我会交到新朋友的，你们也要开心哦。”说完，她抱着那张大卡片，甜甜地睡着了。
pages.text_en: That night, Bubu lay in her little bed at their Shenzhen home. NOMI sat beside her pillow, and NONO dozed on the bedside lamp. Bubu looked at the star-shaped night light on the ceiling and whispered: "Goodnight, friends in Suzhou. Tomorrow I'll make new friends, and you be happy too, okay?" Then she hugged the big card and fell sweetly asleep.
